matches.rationale: GT1 concerns inconsistent assumptions about data distribution (heavy-tailed vs sub-Gaussian, unbounded vs bounded covariance spectrum) in the method section. Finding 1 identifies a mathematical constraint issue in Theorem 3.2's spectral density expression. These are different defects in different locations with different mechanisms.

GT2 concerns the oversimplified definition of generalization loss as L_test - L_train in the method section. Finding 1 addresses a spectral density validity issue in Theorem 3.2. These are unrelated defects in different parts of the paper.
